This omission led CSVProcessing_Expert to use exact string equality for programming languages and a simplistic presence check for second language. As a result, applicants who actually possess qualifying languages were incorrectly flagged as missing that requirement, skewing the count of those missing exactly one qualification to 12 rather than the true 17. This aligns with FM-2.4 (Information Withholding): the agent failed to share insights that would have changed downstream logic and the final decision.
